version.changelog: Simplify the login instructions to the code flow (maton login prints a link; finish with maton login --code <CODE>), drop the API Key subsection, and pin the Maton CLI install to 0.4.0.

llm.summary: This Airtable skill is a disclosed Maton integration for user-approved Airtable API access, with clear cautions around writes, credentials, hosted functions, and persistent triggers.

dimensions.detail: Network access, OAuth login, and access to the user's authorized Airtable data are proportionate to the stated API integration; raw API key use is documented only as a fallback when the CLI is unavailable.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It installs a pinned Maton CLI via npm or Homebrew and optionally SDK packages; this is expected for the integration, but users should understand it adds a local authenticated CLI.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions default to read/list operations and require explicit user approval for new connections, writes, deletes, hosted functions, trigger destinations, and local event execution.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill documents credential storage, hosted functions, scheduled/event triggers, and persistent destinations, but it repeatedly scopes them to user-approved actions and warns about ongoing data forwarding and credential handling.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill purpose is Airtable CRUD and querying through Maton OAuth/API gateway; the documented commands and endpoint examples match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust Maton with your Airtable connection. Prefer OAuth through the CLI, grant the narrowest Airtable scopes available, confirm every write/delete or automation before it runs, and review any trigger destination carefully because it can forward future event data continuously until removed.
